name: English - Controversial Topics in Science and Technology C1
description:
In this hybrid course, students will improve their English by studying and discussing controversial issues in science and technology. The students themselves will determine the specific topics, which they will research and present individually or in small groups.  

Past student topics include the following:

- gene editing in children
- LLMs in university learning
- the nature of consciousness
- climate change debates
- how to label GMO foods
- the future of energy
- biodiversity
- animal ethics
-living architecture

Class time will be largely dedicated to presentations, discussions, and debates. The course emphasizes building vocabulary and spoken fluency but will also help students improve their writing skills.

In-person attendance is best when possible; however, students may attend online as needed.
prerequisites: C1 level of English, verified through the English Placement Test (in Moodle)
